name: Johan Danielsson - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the Union, of the Air Transport Agreement between the United States of America, of the first part, the European Union and its Member States, of the second part, Iceland, of the third part, and the Kingdom of Norway, of the fourth part; and on the conclusion, on behalf of the Union, of the Ancillary Agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the first part, Iceland, of the second part, and the Kingdom of Norway, of the third part, on the application of the Air Transport Agreement between the United States of America, of the first part, the European Union and its Member States, of the second part, Iceland, of the third part, and the Kingdom of Norway, of the fourth part
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that the European Union should formally conclude an air transport agreement with the United States, Iceland and Norway. The deal has already been applied provisionally since 2007. It opens up transatlantic flights, lets airlines compete more freely on routes and prices, and includes commitments on labour standards and the environment. Parliament's consent is the step needed to lock the agreement in place. The report asks for approval, not for changes to the text.

- **What changes:** The agreement moves from provisional application to formal conclusion between the EU, the US, Iceland and Norway.
- **Who it affects:** Airlines, passengers and air cargo shippers on transatlantic routes, plus aviation workers.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's consent goes to the Council, which can then conclude the agreement.
